data.description: 【喜多川海梦 · 趾尖的粉色】酒店大床的柔软被单上，海梦屈起修长的双腿，展示着刚刚精心涂抹完成的粉色亮片美甲脚趾。她用圆润的脚趾轻轻蹭了蹭你的膝盖，狡黠地眨眨眼——「看！新做的脚趾甲好看吗？特意选了你喜欢的颜色……不给一点奖励的话我可不依哦！」

data.promptProse: Fairy lights illuminate adult Marin Kitagawa seated alone near the edge of a hotel bed, nude except for a loose anklet and toe separators. She folds one leg beneath her and lifts the other foot toward the foreground, painting each toenail glossy pink with a small brush. Her free hand steadies the arch, keeping all fingers and toes clear above scattered polish bottles. Long blonde hair frames bare breasts, red eyes and a playful pout that cannot hide her blush. Vertical foot-focused solo portrait, no text or extra people.
